title: Lane lint runs its quick checks first and stops at the first fail
why: Coordinator, 05:00 CST Nov 9: lane stack-cross-measure (#2410) lost a lane-lint run of about 15 min to a silent-undo fail that the 0.2 s silent-undo check would have shown first.
note: Fix: `merge --lane-lint` runs the silent-undo check and the other quick checks before the long steps, and stops at the first fail. It touches merge.py, so it starts after #2378, with steps lane-lint-checks-from-batch and lint-verdict-in-reviewed. Related: step lane-lint-mutant-anchors. Filed 05:01 CST Nov 9.
